goal: Abort node startup with clear errors when numeric configuration options are out of bounds
Prevent silent sign wrapping or truncation that breaks database flushing or traps nodes in sync
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile with no blockers invalidating review
agreement: Verified by testing changed options on regtest to confirm invalid values fail startup (ryanofsky)
Approach objection wanting validation handled centrally in the argument parser instead (sedited)
Unaddressed objections over manual call-site parsing and using wrong integer types (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection about temporary string bindings causing CI test failures (l0rinc)

categories.name: mempool
why: P4 because it only validates startup flags rather than changing mempool policy or structures
It prevents negative expiry settings from immediately purging the mempool but has marginal impact

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because invalid numeric arguments previously caused severe runtime misbehavior
Bad configuration inputs could disable database flushing or permanently stall block sync
Cleanly failing startup protects node operators from silent data corruption and stalls

categories.name: wallet
why: P4 because it only sanitizes startup configuration inputs rather than altering wallet logic
It avoids out-of-bounds fee confirmation targets silently forcing fallback transaction fees
